scope: Final production sources plus a test-only fixed BindableFunction hook. Two actual clients: one hero and one existing human-controlled Pig. Prepared actions reposition existing bodies, anchor other enemies far away, move the target during an accepted grab for the miss case, inject one existing Session Punch hit into the carrier and invoke one existing lifecycle death. No HP/respawn values are directly set. Actual keyboard/touch inputs move, jump, grab, throw and attempt held/thrown enemy commands. The final live1HP enemy dies from real physics below the kill plane after the edge throw. This is not a full unprepared level or actual reconnect/physical phone test.

preparationHook:
-- Prepared acceptance only; absent from repository production entry/build.
local qa=Instance.new('BindableFunction');qa.Name='BrickToadsCarryQA';qa.Parent=game.ServerStorage
local refs
local missTriggered=false
qa.OnInvoke=function(action)
 local c=controller.groups['group-1'].controller
 local w=c.world;local s=c.current;local e=c.director and c.director.enemies[-1]
 if action=='prepare' then
  assert(s and e and e.ownerUserId,'claim human Pig first')
  for id,a in w.actors do if id<0 and id~=-1 then a.root.Anchored=true;a.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(-10,3,id==-2 and 20 or -20)) end end
  local h,p=w.actors[1],w.actors[-1]
  h.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-65,3,-7),Vector3.new(-62.4,3,-7)))
  p.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-62.4,3,-7),Vector3.new(-65,3,-7)))
  h.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero;p.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
  if not refs then
   local collisions={};for _,part in p.model:GetDescendants()do if part:IsA('BasePart')then collisions[part]=part.CanCollide end end
   refs={enemyModel=p.model,enemyRoot=p.root,heroActor=s.state.heroes[1].actorId,enemyActor=e.actorId,collisions=collisions}
  end
 elseif action=='armMiss' then
  task.spawn(function() local deadline=os.clock()+1.5;while os.clock()<deadline do if c.director.carry.pendingBySlot[1] then local p=w.actors[-1];p.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(-56,3,-7));p.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero;missTriggered=true;return end;task.wait()end end)
 elseif action=='hurtHolder' then s:_hit(-2,1,'Punch')
 elseif action=='killHolder' then s:_die(1,'PreparedHolderDeath')
 elseif action=='edge' then
  local h=w.actors[1];h.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-65,3,23.5),Vector3.new(-65,3,26)))
  h.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
 end
 local result={missTriggered=missTriggered,state=s and s:snapshot(),level=c.director and c.director:snapshot(),logs=s and s.logs}
 if e and refs then
  local h,p=w.actors[1],w.actors[-1];local match=true;local collidable=0
  for part,original in refs.collisions do if part.Parent then if part.CanCollide then collidable+=1 end;if part.CanCollide~=original then match=false end end end
  local pos,vel=p.root.Position,p.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
  local hp=h.root.Position
  result.enemy={sameModel=p.model==refs.enemyModel,sameRoot=p.root==refs.enemyRoot,sameActor=e.actorId==refs.enemyActor,
   owner=e.ownerUserId,health=e.health,dead=e.dead,carryState=c.director.carry:stateFor(-1),
   evaluateStateMachine=p.humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine,anchored=p.root.Anchored,platformStand=p.humanoid.PlatformStand,walkSpeed=p.humanoid.WalkSpeed,
   carryMode=p.model:GetAttribute('CarryMode'),heldBy=p.model:GetAttribute('HeldBy'),
   collisionsRestored=match,collidableParts=collidable,position={pos.X,pos.Y,pos.Z},velocity={vel.X,vel.Y,vel.Z}}
  result.hero={sameOriginalActor=s.state.heroes[1].actorId==refs.heroActor,position={hp.X,hp.Y,hp.Z},
   carrying=h.model:GetAttribute('CarryingEnemy'),actorId=s.state.heroes[1].actorId}
  result.ownerView=c.director:controlled(e.ownerUserId)
 end
 return game.HttpService:JSONEncode(result)
end

preFix.description: Old source let the R6 Humanoid re-enable Torso.CanCollide during carry. Actual property inspection found EvaluateStateMachine=true. Runtime experiment false+allpartsfalse stayed noncolliding; World now preserves/restores this property. An initial F+A attempt captured before movement; it is not counted as a successful miss test.
